blocks.text: Woh mutations jin mein sirf aik ya chand nucleotides badalte hain, point mutations kehlati hain. Aam misalein yeh hain:

items: Substitutions: aik nucleotide ki jagah doosra nucleotide aa jata hai, maslan replication ke dauran A ki jagah G, ya C ki jagah T.
Insertions: DNA mein aik ya zyada izafi (extra) nucleotides jur jate hain; yeh aam taur par replication ki ghaltiyon se hota hai.
Deletions: DNA se aik ya zyada nucleotides nikal jate hain.

blocks.title: For Information
blocks.text: Gene mutation aik gene ki kimiyai banawat mein kisi bhi tabdeeli ka aam naam hai. Yeh "molecular level" (nucleotide sequence) ki tabdeeli hai, "chromosomal level" (DNA ke bare tukron) ki nahin. Point mutations sab se aam gene mutations hain.

blocks.alt: Aik hi DNA aur us ki protein ki chaar qataarein. Normal DNA TAT CAT CCT AAG GTA, protein Tyr-His-Pro-Lys-Val. Substitution TAT CAT CGT AAG GTA, Tyr-His-Arg-Lys-Val. Insertion TAT CAT CGC TAA GGT A, Tyr-His-Arg-Stop. Deletion TAT CTC CTA AGG TA, Tyr-Leu-Leu-Arg-... Badle hue bases aur amino acids surkh hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 19.23: Point mutations (kitab ki Figure 19.23 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Substitution mein aksar sirf aik amino acid badalta hai (Pro ki jagah Arg). Insertion ya deletion se reading frame (teen teen ki ginti) khisak jata hai, is liye us ke baad saare codons badal jate hain aur jaldi stop codon bhi aa sakta hai.
Point mutations ke zaraye (sources)
1- DNA ko jismani nuqsan (physical damage)

Ionizing radiation: zyada energy wali radiation, jaise X rays aur gamma rays, bohat mutagenic (mutation paida karne wali) hain. Yeh atoms ko free radicals mein badal deti hain jo DNA strand ke phosphodiester bonds (nucleotides ko jorne wale bonds) tor sakte hain.

Ultraviolet radiation: DNA UV radiation ko zor se jazb (absorb) karta hai. Jab saath saath wale do pyrimidine nucleotides (C aur T) UV jazb karte hain to un ke darmiyan covalent bonds ban jate hain (kitab ise double covalent bond kehti hai). Is se replication bilkul ruk sakti hai.
2- Mutagen chemicals

Bohat si point mutations mutagen chemicals se hoti hain. Kuch chemicals nucleotides jaise hote hain aur DNA mein shamil ho jate hain; aisa DNA theek se transcribe nahin hota. Kuch chemicals adenine ya cytosine se amino group hata dete hain jis se woh ghalat jore banate hain (mis-pair), aur kuch nucleotides par hydrocarbon groups laga dete hain, jis se bhi ghalat jore bante hain. Aise mutagen chemicals laboratories mein aam istemal hote hain aur kabhi mahol mein bhi chhoot jate hain (maslan mustard gas).
3- Khud ba khud (spontaneous) point mutations

Bohat si point mutations khud ba khud hoti hain. Kabhi nucleotides khud hi apni doosri shakal (alternative position) mein chale jate hain; replication mein DNA polymerase is badle hue nucleotide ke saamne ghalat nucleotide laga deta hai. Kabhi homologous chromosomes ke jorne par nucleotide sequences theek seedh mein nahin aate; aik strand ka hissa loop (chhalla) bana kar bahar nikal aata hai. Cell yeh loop kaat deta hai, aur aik chromosome se kai sau nucleotides kam (delete) ho jate hain.

blocks.title: Insanon mein chhoti mutations
blocks.text:
Single nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs): aik nucleotide ki tabdeeli. Yeh bohat aam hain; bezarar bhi ho sakti hain aur halka asar bhi daal sakti hain. Maslan gene mein aik base ki tabdeeli se insan doodh (lactose) hazam karne ke qabil nahin rehta.
Insertions aur deletions: aik ya zyada nucleotides ka barhna ya kam hona. Maslan Cystic Fibrosis ki aam wajah aik gene mein sirf teen nucleotides ka deletion hai; is se aik khaas amino acid nikal jata hai, protein theek se fold nahin hota (murta nahin), aur phephron aur hazme ke masail hote hain.
Silent mutations: protein ke amino acids ki tarteeb nahin badalti. Maslan mRNA codon GGC se GGU ho jaye (DNA mein GGC se GGT): genetic code ki degeneracy ki wajah se dono glycine hi dete hain.
Missense mutations: sirf aik amino acid badalta hai, jo protein ka kaam mutasir kar sakta hai. Maslan haemoglobin ke gene mein aik nucleotide ki tabdeeli (A se T) se glutamic acid ki jagah valine aa jata hai. Yeh aik "ghalat" amino acid red blood cells ki gol shakal bigaar deta hai aur sickle cell anaemia hota hai.
Nonsense mutations: protein ke sequence mein waqt se pehle stop codon aa jata hai, is liye protein chhota aur bekaar banta hai. Maslan Duchenne Muscular Dystrophy mein nonsense mutation gene ke beech mein stop signal bana deti hai; protein bohat chhota ban kar kaam nahin karta aur muscles dheere dheere kamzor hote jate hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab silent mutation ki misaal mein likhti hai ke "DNA code" GGC se GGU ho gaya. Lekin U (uracil) sirf RNA mein hota hai, is liye GGC aur GGU mRNA ke codons hain. DNA (coding strand) mein yeh tabdeeli GGC se GGT hogi. mRNA ke dono codons GGC aur GGU glycine dete hain, is liye silent mutation ki misaal baqi durust hai.

blocks.title: Zyada tar mutations nuqsandeh kyun?
blocks.text:
Zyada tar mutations genes ka normal kaam bigaar deti hain aur nuqsandeh saabit hoti hain, maslan:
• Haemoglobin protein mein sirf aik amino acid badalne wali mutation sickle cell anaemia kar sakti hai, jo kamzor kar dene wali aur jaan lewa bhi ho sakti hai.
• Mutations gene regulation bigaar kar jism ki nashonuma (development) badal sakti hain aur cancer jaisi bimariyon ka sabab ban sakti hain.
• Kuch mutations bekaar ya kamzor (unstable) proteins banati hain jo jandar ke liye nuqsandeh hain, maslan phenylketonuria.
Point mutations se hone wali genetic bimariyan

DNA sequence ki tabdeeli se hone wali bimariyan autosomal dominant, autosomal recessive ya X-linked tareeqe se naslon mein muntaqil hoti hain. Aik gene ki mutation se hone wali do ahem bimariyan yeh hain:
1- Sickle cell anaemia

Sickle cell anaemia haemoglobin ki ghair normal β chain ke recessive gene ki wajah se hota hai. Yeh gene chromosome 11 par hai. Is recessive gene mein point mutation hai: DNA ka nucleotide T badal kar A ho jata hai. Is se glutamic acid ka codon CTC badal kar CAC ban jata hai jo valine ka hai (yeh template strand ke triplets hain; mRNA mein GAG se GUG). Agar bachche ko dono recessive (mutant) alleles milen to woh ghair normal β chains banata hai (glutamic acid ki jagah valine). Yeh ghair normal haemoglobin normal se kam oxygen le jata hai aur RBCs darranti (sickle) ki shakal ke ho jate hain. Bari alamaat: dard, thakan, saans phoolna, yarqan (jaundice) aur infections ka zyada khatra.

blocks.alt: Baen: normal DNA, coding GAG aur template CTC; nucleotide substitution se GTG aur CAC. Transcription se mRNA codons GAG aur GUG; translation se amino acids ki zanjeer mein glutamic acid aur valine; in se normal gol red blood cell aur darranti (sickle) shakal ka red blood cell.

blocks.text: Sickle cell anaemia ke ilaaj mein dard kam karne ke liye non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) aur opioids waghaira diye jate hain. Khoon lagane (blood transfusion) se sehatmand RBCs barhte hain. Bone marrow transplant lambe arse ka ilaaj de sakta hai. Baqaida checkup aur bachao ke tareeqe, jaise vaccinations aur antibiotics, pecheedgiyon (complications) se bachate hain.
2- Phenylketonuria

Yeh aik genetic metabolic bimari hai. Chromosome 12 par maujood normal gene jigar ka enzyme phenylalanine hydroxylase (PAH) banata hai, jo amino acid phenylalanine ko tyrosine mein badalta hai. Point mutation (maslan aik nucleotide ki substitution ya deletion) is allele ko recessive bana deti hai. Agar bachche ko dono recessive alleles milen to PAH enzyme theek nahin banta aur us ka kaam kam ho jata hai. Natija yeh ke khoon aur doosre tissues mein phenylalanine zehreeli had tak jama ho sakta hai. Is haalat ko phenylketonuria (PKU) kehte hain.

Bari alamaat: zehni kamzori (intellectual disability), daure (seizures), rawaiye ke masail, zehni bimari, microcephaly (sar ka chhota hona), aur saans, jild aur peshab mein basi boo. Zyada phenylalanine dimagh ko nuqsan bhi pohancha sakta hai.

PKU ke mareezon ko phenylalanine se bhari ghizaon (maslan gosht, doodh ki cheezein, ande aur kuch anaaj) se parhez karna parta hai. Khoon mein phenylalanine ki miqdar baqaida check kar ke ghiza theek ki jati hai. Kuch dawaein khoon ka phenylalanine kam karti hain: sapropterin (PAH ke madadgar cofactor BH4 ki masnooi shakal, jo mareez ke apne PAH ka kaam barhati hai) aur pegvaliase (aik doosra enzyme jo phenylalanine ko tor deta hai). Mareezon ko supplements bhi diye jate hain taa ke woh vitamins aur minerals milte rahen jo kam phenylalanine wali ghiza mein kam ho sakte hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne chhapa hai ke kuch dawaon mein masnooi (synthetic) PAH enzyme hota hai. Aisi koi dawa istemal mein nahi: PKU ki dawaein sapropterin (BH4 co-factor, jo mareez ka bacha hua PAH tez karta hai) aur pegvaliase (phenylalanine ammonia lyase, jo phenylalanine ko torta hai) hain. Dono khoon ka phenylalanine kam karti hain.

blocks.title: Genetic bimariyon ke ilaaj ke mumkina tareeqe
blocks.text:
Gene therapy: kharab (mutated) gene ko theek karna ya us ki jagah kaam karne wala gene lagana.
Cell therapy: maslan type 1 diabetes mein pancreas ke insulin banane wale beta cells kaam nahin karte; cell therapy mein transplant ke zariye in ki jagah sehatmand cells lagaye jate hain.
Pharmacogenomics: mareez ki genetic banawat ke mutabiq dawa chunna; DNA dekh kar doctor us ke liye behtareen dawa maloom karte hain.
Genetic counselling: jin khandanon mein genetic bimariyon ki tareekh ho, unhein maloomat aur madad dena, jis mein genetic testing, bimari ke baare mein taleem, aur family planning ki rehnumai shamil hai.

blocks.prompt: Aik nucleotide ka deletion aam taur par aik nucleotide ki substitution se zyada nuqsan kyun karta hai?
blocks.explanation: Deletion reading frame ko khiska deta hai, is liye us ke baad har codon badal jata hai aur aksar jaldi stop codon aa jata hai. Substitution zyada se zyada aik codon badalti hai aur silent bhi ho sakti hai.

blocks.text: Fauri khulasa

items: Zaraye: ionizing aur UV radiation, mutagen chemicals, khud ba khud ghaltiyan.
Chhoti mutations: SNPs, insertion/deletion, silent, missense, nonsense.
Sickle cell: β chain mein glutamic acid ki jagah valine (chromosome 11); PKU: PAH kam (chromosome 12).
